title: Optimal Control of a Class of Reaction-Diffusion Systems with Pointwise State Constraints
summary: We study optimal control problems governed by a system of semilinear reaction-diffusion equations. The assumptions on the governing system are formulated so that our results apply to several models, including the Brusselator, Schnakenberg, and Gray--Scott systems. We prove the existence and uniqueness of a solution to the governing system without imposing any non-negativity assumption on the data.
